summary: Verified the Jan 2026 PulseFitness fix batch (4 items). Backend: staffing role mapping — 'administrator' now correctly maps to platform 'staff' (unit + coverage of engineer/manager/director/receptionist/None). MOD CRM quote PDF: build_crm_quote_pdf renders `lines` (not just line_items) for mod_sor with a 'TL No.' column, per-line TL numbers from sku (5A, 23A) and SER codes (SER100078, SER100099) in the description; 'No line items' no longer prints. MOD site create endpoint: POST /api/master-admin/mod-estate/sites {force:'raf'} as master admin creates a mod_site org that appears in /site-readiness. Frontend: portal-switch to Pulse, CRM → Companies, New Company dialog is scrollable (max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto verified via getComputedStyle: scrollHeight 1105 > clientHeight 808, overflowY='auto'). Commercial/MOD kind tabs work; MOD tab exposes Army/RAF/Navy branch dropdown; submit label swaps to 'Create MOD Site'. E2E MOD site create (Navy) via CRM UI hit POST /api/master-admin/mod-estate/sites → 200 (mod-site-test-qa-navy-3161 under Royal Navy HQ). Commercial regression: submit still POSTs /api/crm/v2/companies → 200 and navigates to the new company. Test rows cleaned up in Mongo.
critical_code_review_comments: CRMCompanies.js: the first API POST after entering CRM occasionally returns 401 'User not found' before the CRM cross-login token is fully hydrated; UI silently retries and succeeds. Consider awaiting the CRM auth handshake (or blocking dialog submission until ready) so the first submit doesn't need a retry.

CRMCompanies.js MOD path: axios error on the mod-estate POST reads e?.response?.data?.detail — the endpoint returns detail on error but the toast fallback ('Could not create — please try again.') swallows real messages like 'HQ not set up yet'. Minor UX polish.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: created RAF site via API test (auto-cleaned) and a Navy site + Commercial company via UI (both deleted post-run from organizations + crm2_companies with prefix TEST_QA_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 fixes from this batch verified end-to-end. If revisiting: use /crm?tab=companies (NOT /crm/companies which 404s). The New Company dialog uses CompanyAutocomplete with data-testid company-name-autocomplete-input for the name field; the submit button sits below the fold and MUST be scrolled_into_view_if_needed before clicking. There is a transient CRM-token warmup where the first POST can 401 briefly; give it a couple seconds after landing on the CRM page.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — all four target fixes pass.
